head: c5a33851f7f70f5fd946b977e0d811db9071a4ac
commits: c5a33851 S4C-6 smoke and cloud package scripts: builds with 365x24h networks (integrated STEPS, disconnected STEPS + extra-ASEAN CO2 storage, integrated NZE, disconnected diagnostic), three 56x3h smokes with the recommended profile A (formal_barrier + Kirchhoff normalisation)

69cf1f29 S4C-5 results (decision 84): Kirchhoff row-normalisation equivalence and solver-setting comparison on the 56x3h integrated main; recommendation A (formal_barrier + normalisation), cloud time extrapolation
7ab18faa S4C-5 (part 1, before the runs): Kirchhoff-Voltage-Law row normalisation (decision 69 c under decision 84), solver profile C, comparison script; S4C-3 config-hash fix
6eea697d S4C-4: extra-ASEAN CO2 storage option (decision 89) - unit cost 40.75 EUR2020/t from IEAGHG 2004 ship transport + ZEP 2011 offshore storage, switch on | off
93d2d922 S4C-3: international bunker attribution (decision 88, modifying decision 10) - asean_pool main, bunkering_country and excluded as switch values

9a5ea111 S4C-2: hydro inflow renormalisation (decision 83, user decision 2026-10-17 option B) - national inflow = Ember 2019-2025 median x 1.1 by capacity share; option A and frozen_base as switch values
315b22da S4C-2 (diagnosis, stopped): hydro inflow diagnosis per country against IRENA 2023 and Ember 2019-2025; stop report (mechanism only partly confirmed)

077ebd0b S4C-1: wind / solar and electric-base candidates on the decision-50 cost layer, offshore connection cost, full component cost audit (decision 82); corridor subsea shares (supplement 01, decision 16)
24c0b552 S4C-1 (partial): force-add the distance and subsea-share CSV tables (root .gitignore *.csv)
d7e93d20 S4C-1 (partial, stopped): offshore-wind connection distances and geometric corridor subsea shares; stop report for the user decision
901b354e S4C-0: fossil fuel prices on WEO 2025 STEPS (decision 85), small items (decision 86), discount rate and WACC switch (decision 90)
label: SMOKE_TEST_ONLY results have no scientific meaning before the cloud run (decision 47)
